test_title: PYST 6: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate adverb.

We find him ________ intelligent.
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. **very**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The adverb **"very"** is used to emphasize the adjective **"intelligent."**
 
• The word **"too"** (Option 1) implies an excess, which is not suitable in this context as no negative implication is intended.
